text: てもちの　ポケモンが　１ひきの　ばあいは　あずけられません！

structure.jp: てもちの　ポケモンが　１ひきの　ばあいは
structure.en: in the case that your party has one Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜ばあいは
patterns.explanation: ばあいは means 'in the case that', a formal way to say 'if'. １ひきの ばあいは = 'if there is only one'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Adding られる to あずける makes it 'can deposit', and ません makes it 'cannot'. あずけられません = 'you can't deposit it'.
